name: Ray Marching with Shadow Mapping
aliases: Ray Marching with Shadow Mapping — Opacity Shadow Map Volume Rendering
definition: A ray marching algorithm that computes volume illumination by integrating light along a ray, using an opacity shadow map to determine occlusion by the volume itself.
summary: Ray Marching with Shadow Mapping is an efficient volume rendering technique that precomputes transmittance from the light's perspective to determine self-occlusion, avoiding expensive per-ray light sampling.
